exposure: Infants who did not receive probiotics
cohort: 665 infants with very low birth weight in the neonatal intensive care unit
finding: Routine use of Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus probiotics in infants with very low birth weight did not significantly affect the incidence and severity of necrotizing enterocolitis but was associated with fewer overall infections.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was similar between the group that received probiotics and the group that did not.
